result.title: Toward Sustainable Agentic AI: Carbon Tradeoffs Across Iterative Self-Refinement and Tool-Augmented Coding
result.comment: Presented at the GREEN AI workshop @CIKM 2026
result.summary: Agentic language model systems can improve performance either by iterating on their own outputs or by using external tools in grounded environments. While these strategies can reduce error rates and substitute for larger models in some settings, their environmental cost remains relatively underexplored. We present two complementary empirical studies that estimate the energy and carbon footprint of agentic AI across settings of increasing complexity. Study~1 evaluates iterative verbal self-refinement: GPT-4.1-mini at $k = 1$--$5$ steps versus a GPT-4.1 single-pass baseline on two MATH benchmark splits. Study~2 evaluates tool-augmented agentic coding: GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Opus~4.6, and GPT-5.3-codex on SWE-bench Lite, where agents operate inside Docker-isolated environments with access to code execution and file editing tools. In Study~1, $k=3$ refinements close a 16-percentage-point accuracy gap to within 1~point, but nearly triple the carbon footprint relative to the cheap single-pass baseline while remaining below the GPT-4.1 single-pass baseline under the current token-based carbon scenario. In Study~2, GPT-5.3-codex achieves the highest resolution rate in this sample (81.2\%), ahead of Claude Opus~4.6 (68.9\%) and GPT-4.1-mini (25.0\%), but resolved-task-normalized efficiency remains mixed: GPT-4.1-mini is lowest on estimated carbon and cost per resolved task, while GPT-5.3-codex delivers substantially higher task success. All carbon estimates cover output-token inference only; prompt tokens, which exceed 99\% of tokens in Study~2, and tool execution are not charged, so the figures are lower bounds on the full agentic footprint.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用两项实证研究估算 agentic AI 的能耗与碳排放：一是在 MATH 上比较 GPT-4.1-mini 多步自我精炼（k=1–5）与单次强模型基线的精度—碳成本权衡；二是在 SWE-bench Lite 上比较三个模型在 Docker 环境中使用代码执行与文件编辑工具时的正确率与「按解决任务归一化」的碳、成本效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「迭代步数/工具调用的收益—碳成本」核算与「每成功任务效率」归一化，可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类动态计算策略的成本侧度量；但只计输出 token、无视觉输入与 latent 状态，与 LVR 机制本身联系较远，属外围借鉴线索。
